segments.caption: A yellow Komatsu excavator operates on a frozen or icy waterway, using its bucket to rescue people from the water. A crowd of onlookers stands on the ice nearby, while another excavator is visible in the background. The scene depicts a dramatic, large-scale rescue operation in a cold, open environment.

In a dramatic rescue unfolding on a turbulent, icy waterway, a yellow excavator with a large bucket is used to lift and carry several people from the dangerous, churning water. The excavator, branded with "CAT" and "KOMATSU," maneuvers its bucket to scoop up individuals who appear to be in distress, holding on tightly as the bucket is raised out of the water. A dramatic rescue unfolds as a yellow excavator, with its massive bucket lowered into turbulent water, ferries several people to safety. The bucket, acting as a makeshift boat, carries the individuals through the rough waves, while onlookers watch from the riverbank. The scene captures the perilous conditions and the critical, coordinated effort to save lives using heavy machinery.

A group of people are seen climbing into the bucket of a large yellow excavator, with one individual already inside and others assisting them. The scene takes place in a snowy, rugged outdoor area near a body of water, and a crowd of onlookers gathers nearby, watching the unusual activity. The excavator then begins to move, carrying the people within its bucket.

A crowd gathers on a muddy riverbank as a yellow excavator maneuvers its bucket into the water, rescuing a person who was submerged. The excavator carefully lifts the individual, who is wearing a dark jacket and cap, out of the turbulent water, while onlookers watch anxiously from the shore.

A group of people, including rescuers in dark uniforms, work together to save a person from icy water using a yellow Caterpillar excavator. The excavator's bucket is used to carefully lift the person out of the water, while onlookers watch from the shore as the rescue operation unfolds.
A person is rescued from icy water by being lifted out of the water in the bucket of a yellow excavator, then carefully helped out by responders onto a rocky shore.

A yellow Komatsu excavator operates on a partially frozen body of water, using its bucket to carefully lift a large, dark, cylindrical object—likely a submerged pipe or structure—from the icy surface. A crowd of onlookers stands on the far bank, observing the operation as the excavator works methodically to retrieve the object from the water.
